#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Trigger health checks for all VMs ──
# Usage: health-all-vms.sh
# In GHA: triggers per-VM workflow_dispatch via gh CLI
# In CLI/Dagu: runs health-check-vm.sh directly for each VM
set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"

VMS="gcp-proxy gcp-t4 oci-apps oci-analytics oci-mail"

if [ -n "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" ]; then
  # In GHA: trigger individual workflows
  REPO="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-diegonmarcos/cloud}"
  for vm in $VMS; do
    echo "Triggering health-${vm}.yml"
    gh workflow run "health-${vm}.yml" --repo "$REPO" --ref main || echo "WARN: failed to trigger $vm"
  done
  gh workflow run "health-http-public.yml" --repo "$REPO" --ref main || true
  gh workflow run "health-http-private.yml" --repo "$REPO" --ref main || true
else
  # In CLI/Dagu: run health-check-vm.sh directly
  for vm in $VMS; do
    echo "── Health: $vm ──"
    bash "$SCRIPT_DIR/health-check-vm.sh" "$vm" || echo "FAIL: $vm"
  done
fi

name: "Health → all VMs"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"  # daily at 06:00 UTC

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  vms:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        vm: [gcp-proxy, gcp-t4, oci-apps, oci-analytics, oci-mail]
    steps:
      - name: Trigger ${{ matrix.vm }} health check
        run: gh workflow run "health-${{ matrix.vm }}.yml" --repo "${{ github.repository }}" --ref main
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  http-public:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger HTTP public health check
        run: gh workflow run "health-http-public.yml" --repo "${{ github.repository }}" --ref main
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  http-private:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger HTTP private (.app) health check
        run: gh workflow run "health-http-private.yml" --repo "${{ github.repository }}" --ref main
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

dags/gha/health-check-vm.sh

#!/bin/sh
# Health check for a single VM — container status + port checks (async)
# Usage: health-check-vm.sh <ssh-alias> <ports> [known-flaky]
#   ssh-alias:   SSH config alias (e.g. oci-apps, gcp-proxy)
#   ports:       comma-separated port list (e.g. 80,443,8080)
#   known-flaky: comma-separated container names that warn instead of fail
set -e

ALIAS="${1:?Usage: $0 <ssh-alias> <ports> [known-flaky]}"
PORTS="${2:?Usage: $0 <ssh-alias> <ports> [known-flaky]}"
KNOWN_FLAKY="${3:-}"

CONTAINERS="/tmp/containers.txt"
PORT_RESULTS="/tmp/port_results"
mkdir -p "$PORT_RESULTS"

# ── Container health ──
echo "=== $ALIAS container health ==="
ssh "$ALIAS" 'docker ps --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}" 2>&1' | tee "$CONTAINERS"

failed=0
warned=0
while IFS=$(printf '\t') read -r name status; do
  [ -z "$name" ] && continue
  if printf '%s' "$status" | grep -qiE 'Restarting|unhealthy|Exited'; then
    if [ -n "$KNOWN_FLAKY" ] && printf '%s' ",$KNOWN_FLAKY," | grep -q ",$name,"; then
      echo "::warning::$name — $status (known-flaky, non-blocking)"
      ssh -n "$ALIAS" "docker logs $name --tail 10 2>&1" || true
      warned=$((warned + 1))
    else
      echo "::error::$name — $status"
      ssh -n "$ALIAS" "docker logs $name --tail 10 2>&1" || true
      failed=$((failed + 1))
    fi
  else
    echo "✓ $name — $status"
  fi
done < "$CONTAINERS"

# ── Port checks (async) ──
echo ""
echo "=== Port checks ==="
IFS=','
for port in $PORTS; do
  (
    if ssh -n "$ALIAS" "timeout 2 bash -c 'echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$port' 2>/dev/null"; then
      echo "PASS $port" > "$PORT_RESULTS/$port"
    else
      echo "FAIL $port" > "$PORT_RESULTS/$port"
    fi
  ) &
done
unset IFS
wait

# Collect port results
port_fail=0
for f in "$PORT_RESULTS"/*; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  result=$(cat "$f")
  port=$(echo "$result" | awk '{print $2}')
  case "$result" in
    PASS*) echo "✓ :$port open" ;;
    FAIL*) echo "✗ :$port closed"; port_fail=$((port_fail + 1)) ;;
  esac
done

# ── Summary ──
echo ""
[ "$warned" -gt 0 ] && echo "::warning::$warned known-flaky container(s) unhealthy (non-blocking)"
[ "$port_fail" -gt 0 ] && echo "::warning::$port_fail port(s) closed"

if [ "$failed" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::$failed container(s) unhealthy"
  echo ""
  echo "=== Debug dump ==="
  ssh -n "$ALIAS" 'free -m; echo "---"; uptime; echo "---"; df -h / 2>/dev/null' || true
  exit 1
fi
echo "All containers healthy"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Full cloud health diagnostic ──
# Usage: health-cloud-full.sh
# Runs health_cloud.ts inside c3-infra-mcp container (or locally with tsx)
set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

SSH="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"

# Try running inside the MCP container on oci-apps (has all deps + SSH keys)
RESULT=$($SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.6 "docker exec c3-infra-mcp-api npx tsx mcp/tools/health_cloud.ts 2>&1" 2>/dev/null) || true

# Fallback: run locally if tsx is available
if [ -z "$RESULT" ] && command -v tsx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  RESULT=$(cd "$REPO_ROOT/a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-infra-mcp/src" && tsx mcp/tools/health_cloud.ts 2>&1) || true
fi

if [ -z "$RESULT" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: health_cloud.ts returned empty output"
  exit 1
fi

echo "$RESULT"

# Check for failures
FAILS=$(echo "$RESULT" | grep -c '✗' || echo 0)
[ "$FAILS" -gt 0 ] && exit 1
exit 0

dags/gha/health-http-private.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Check all .app DNS resolution (private mesh) ──
# Usage: health-http-private.sh
# Resolves all .app names via hickory-dns on gcp-proxy
set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

DNS_FILE="cloud-data/cloud-data-dns-services.json"
[ ! -f "$DNS_FILE" ] && echo "ERROR: $DNS_FILE not found" >&2 && exit 1

NAMES=$(jq -r '.services | keys[]' "$DNS_FILE" | sort)
TOTAL=$(echo "$NAMES" | wc -w)
echo "Resolving $TOTAL .app names..."

# Build batch dig script for single SSH call
SCRIPT=""
for name in $NAMES; do
  SCRIPT="$SCRIPT echo \"==$name==\"; dig +short ${name}.app @10.0.0.1 2>/dev/null | head -1;"
done

BATCH_RESULT=$(ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 gcp-proxy "$SCRIPT" 2>/dev/null) || {
  echo "ERROR: SSH to gcp-proxy failed"
  exit 1
}

PASS_N=0; FAIL_N=0; WARN_N=0
CURRENT_NAME=""

echo "$BATCH_RESULT" | while read -r line; do
  if echo "$line" | command grep -q "^==.*==$"; then
    CURRENT_NAME=$(echo "$line" | awk -F'==' '{print $2}')
  elif [ -n "$CURRENT_NAME" ]; then
    RESOLVED="$line"
    EXPECTED=$(jq -r ".services[\"$CURRENT_NAME\"].ip // \"\"" "$DNS_FILE")
    if [ -z "$RESOLVED" ]; then
      echo "⚠ ${CURRENT_NAME}.app → no zone"
      WARN_N=$((WARN_N + 1))
    elif [ "$RESOLVED" = "$EXPECTED" ]; then
      echo "✓ ${CURRENT_NAME}.app → $RESOLVED"
      PASS_N=$((PASS_N + 1))
    else
      echo "✗ ${CURRENT_NAME}.app → expected=$EXPECTED got=$RESOLVED"
      FAIL_N=$((FAIL_N + 1))
    fi
    CURRENT_NAME=""
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "RESULT: $PASS_N passed, $FAIL_N failed, $WARN_N warnings"
[ "$FAIL_N" -gt 0 ] && exit 1
exit 0

name: "Health → HTTP private (.app)"

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - "Ship → gcp-proxy"
      - "Ship → oci-apps"
      - "Ship → oci-mail"
      - "Ship → oci-analytics"
      - "Ship → gcp-t4"
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"

concurrency:
  group: health-http-private
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Update submodules to latest
        run: git submodule update --remote

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-deps
        with:
          ssh_key: ${{ secrets.GCP_PROXY_SSH_KEY }}
          ssh_host: ${{ secrets.GCP_PROXY_HOST }}
          ssh_user: ${{ secrets.GCP_PROXY_USER }}
          ssh_alias: gcp-proxy
          sops_age_key: ${{ secrets.SOPS_AGE_KEY }}

      - name: Check all .app DNS (single SSH, batch dig)
        run: |
          DNS_FILE="cloud-data/cloud-data-dns-services.json"
          [ ! -f "$DNS_FILE" ] || [ ! -s "$DNS_FILE" ] && echo "::error::$DNS_FILE missing" && exit 1

          # Build batch dig script — single SSH call resolves ALL names
          NAMES=$(jq -r '.services | keys[]' "$DNS_FILE" | sort)
          SCRIPT=""
          for name in $NAMES; do
            SCRIPT="$SCRIPT echo \"==$name==\"; dig +short ${name}.app @10.0.0.1 2>/dev/null | head -1;"
          done

          echo "=== Resolving $(echo "$NAMES" | wc -w) .app names via single SSH ==="
          BATCH_RESULT=$(ssh gcp-proxy "$SCRIPT" 2>/dev/null)

          # Parse results + compare with expected IPs
          RESULTS="/tmp/dns-results.txt"
          > "$RESULTS"
          CURRENT_NAME=""

          echo "$BATCH_RESULT" | while read -r line; do
            if echo "$line" | grep -q "^==.*==$"; then
              CURRENT_NAME=$(echo "$line" | awk -F'==' '{print $2}')
            elif [ -n "$CURRENT_NAME" ]; then
              RESOLVED="$line"
              EXPECTED=$(jq -r ".services[\"$CURRENT_NAME\"].ip // \"\"" "$DNS_FILE")
              if [ -z "$RESOLVED" ]; then
                echo "WARN|${CURRENT_NAME}.app|no zone" >> "$RESULTS"
              elif [ "$RESOLVED" = "$EXPECTED" ]; then
                echo "PASS|${CURRENT_NAME}.app|$RESOLVED" >> "$RESULTS"
              else
                echo "FAIL|${CURRENT_NAME}.app|expected=$EXPECTED got=$RESOLVED" >> "$RESULTS"
              fi
              CURRENT_NAME=""
            fi
          done

          # Also batch-test VM reachability (SSH port 22 on each unique IP)
          UNIQUE_IPS=$(jq -r '[.services[].ip] | unique[]' "$DNS_FILE")
          for ip in $UNIQUE_IPS; do
            (
              if ssh gcp-proxy "timeout 2 bash -c 'echo > /dev/tcp/$ip/22' 2>/dev/null"; then
                echo "PASS|VM $ip|reachable" >> "$RESULTS"
              else
                echo "WARN|VM $ip|unreachable" >> "$RESULTS"
              fi
            ) &
          done
          wait

          # Report
          echo ""
          echo "════════════════════════════════════════"
          PASS_N=$(grep -c "^PASS" "$RESULTS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          FAIL_N=$(grep -c "^FAIL" "$RESULTS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
          WARN_N=$(grep -c "^WARN" "$RESULTS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)

          grep "^PASS" "$RESULTS" | awk -F'|' '{print "✓ " $2 " → " $3}'
          grep "^WARN" "$RESULTS" | awk -F'|' '{print "⚠ " $2 " — " $3}'
          grep "^FAIL" "$RESULTS" | awk -F'|' '{print "::error::" $2 " — " $3}'

          echo ""
          echo "RESULT: $PASS_N passed, $FAIL_N failed, $WARN_N warnings"
          [ "$FAIL_N" -gt 0 ] && exit 1
          echo "All .app DNS entries correct"

dags/gha/health-http-public.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Check all public HTTP endpoints ──
# Usage: health-http-public.sh
# Reads caddy-routes.json, curls every public domain
set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

R="cloud-data/cloud-data-caddy-routes.json"
[ ! -f "$R" ] && echo "ERROR: $R not found" >&2 && exit 1

URLS="/tmp/urls-$$.txt"
> "$URLS"

# Subdomain routes
jq -r '.routes[] | select(.domain) | "https://\(.domain)/|\(.auth // "two_factor")|\(.comment // .domain)"' "$R" >> "$URLS" 2>/dev/null
# Path routes
jq -r '.path_routes[]? | .parent_domain as $p | .paths[]? | select(.upstream) | "https://\($p)\(.base_path)/|\(.auth // "two_factor")|\(.comment // .base_path)"' "$R" >> "$URLS" 2>/dev/null
# GitHub Pages
jq -r '.github_pages_proxies[]? | "https://\(.domain | split(",") | .[0] | gsub("^ +| +$";""))/|none|\(.comment // .domain)"' "$R" >> "$URLS" 2>/dev/null
# MCP endpoints
jq -r '.mcp_routes[]? | .parent_domain as $p | .endpoints[]? | "https://\($p)\(.base_path)/mcp|mcp|\(.base_path)"' "$R" >> "$URLS" 2>/dev/null

TOTAL=$(wc -l < "$URLS")
echo "Checking $TOTAL public URLs..."

RESULTS="/tmp/results-$$"
mkdir -p "$RESULTS"

BEARER="${OIDC_TOKEN:-${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN:-}}"

check_url() {
  local idx="$1" url="$2" auth="$3" name="$4"
  local hdr=""
  [ "$auth" != "none" ] && [ "$auth" != "mcp" ] && [ -n "$BEARER" ] && hdr="-H 'Authorization: Bearer $BEARER'"
  local code
  code=$(eval curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 $hdr "'$url'" 2>/dev/null)

  if [ "$auth" = "mcp" ] && { [ "$code" = "400" ] || [ "$code" = "405" ]; }; then
    echo "PASS|$name|$code" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
  elif [ "$code" = "000" ] || [ "$code" = "502" ] || [ "$code" = "503" ]; then
    echo "FAIL|$name|$code" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
  else
    echo "PASS|$name|$code" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
  fi
}

IDX=0
while IFS='|' read -r url auth name; do
  check_url "$IDX" "$url" "$auth" "$name" &
  IDX=$((IDX + 1))
done < "$URLS"
wait

PASS_N=0; FAIL_N=0
for f in "$RESULTS"/*; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  LINE=$(cat "$f")
  STATUS=${LINE%%|*}
  REST=${LINE#*|}
  case "$STATUS" in
    PASS) echo "✓ $REST"; PASS_N=$((PASS_N + 1)) ;;
    FAIL) echo "✗ $REST"; FAIL_N=$((FAIL_N + 1)) ;;
  esac
done

rm -rf "$URLS" "$RESULTS"
echo ""
echo "RESULT: $PASS_N passed, $FAIL_N failed (of $TOTAL)"
[ "$FAIL_N" -gt 0 ] && exit 1
exit 0

name: "Health → HTTP public"

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - "Ship → gcp-proxy"
      - "Ship → oci-apps"
      - "Ship → oci-mail"
      - "Ship → oci-analytics"
      - "Ship → gcp-t4"
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * *"

concurrency:
  group: health-http-public
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Update submodules to latest
        run: git submodule update --remote

      - name: Build URL list from Caddy routes
        id: urls
        run: |
          R="cloud-data/cloud-data-caddy-routes.json"
          [ ! -f "$R" ] && echo "::error::$R not found" && exit 1
          URLS="/tmp/urls.txt"
          > "$URLS"

          # Subdomain routes
          jq -r '.routes[] | "https://\(.domain)/|\(.auth // "two_factor")|\(.comment // .domain)"' "$R" >> "$URLS"
          # Path routes
          jq -r '.path_routes[]? | .parent_domain as $p | .paths[]? | "https://\($p)\(.base_path)/|\(.auth // "two_factor")|\(.comment // .base_path)"' "$R" >> "$URLS"
          # GitHub Pages
          jq -r '.github_pages_proxies[]? | "https://\(.domain | split(",") | .[0] | gsub("^ +| +$";""))/|none|\(.comment // .domain)"' "$R" >> "$URLS"
          # MCP (expect 400 = alive)
          jq -r '.mcp_routes[]? | .parent_domain as $p | .endpoints[]? | "https://\($p)\(.base_path)/mcp|mcp|\(.comment // .base_path)"' "$R" >> "$URLS"
          # Special
          jq -r '.special | to_entries[]? | select(.value.domain) | "https://\(.value.domain)/|two_factor|\(.key)"' "$R" >> "$URLS"

          echo "total=$(wc -l < "$URLS")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Generated $(wc -l < "$URLS") URLs to check"

      - name: Check all URLs (async)
        env:
          OIDC_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.AUTHELIA_OIDC_BEARER_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          URLS="/tmp/urls.txt"
          RESULTS="/tmp/results"
          mkdir -p "$RESULTS"

          check() {
            local idx="$1" url="$2" auth="$3" name="$4"
            local hdr=""
            [ "$auth" != "none" ] && [ "$auth" != "public" ] && [ "$auth" != "mcp" ] && [ -n "$OIDC_TOKEN" ] && hdr="-H 'Authorization: Bearer $OIDC_TOKEN'"
            local code
            code=$(eval curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 --location-trusted $hdr "'$url'" 2>/dev/null)

            if [ "$auth" = "mcp" ]; then
              # MCP: 400/405 = alive
              if [ "$code" = "400" ] || [ "$code" = "405" ] || [ "$code" = "406" ]; then
                echo "PASS|$name|$url|$code" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
              else
                echo "FAIL|$name|$url|$code" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
              fi
            elif [ "$code" = "000" ]; then
              echo "FAIL|$name|$url|TIMEOUT" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
            elif [ "$code" = "502" ] || [ "$code" = "503" ]; then
              echo "FAIL|$name|$url|$code" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
            elif [ "$code" = "401" ] || [ "$code" = "403" ]; then
              # ntfy uses its own auth (JWT/tk_/cookie) — 401 means it's alive and serving its login
              if [ "$name" = "ntfy" ] && [ "$code" = "401" ]; then
                echo "PASS|$name|$url|$code (own auth)" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
              else
                echo "WARN|$name|$url|$code" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
              fi
            else
              echo "PASS|$name|$url|$code" > "$RESULTS/$idx"
            fi
          }

          # Launch ALL checks in parallel
          IDX=0
          while IFS='|' read -r url auth name; do
            check "$IDX" "$url" "$auth" "$name" &
            IDX=$((IDX + 1))
          done < "$URLS"

          # Wait for all
          wait

          # Also check L4 TCP ports in parallel
          jq -r '.l4_routes[]? | "\(.port)|\(.comment // "port")"' "cloud-data/cloud-data-caddy-routes.json" | while IFS='|' read -r port comment; do
            (
              if timeout 3 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/mail.diegonmarcos.com/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "PASS|L4 :$port $comment|tcp://$port|OK" > "$RESULTS/l4_$port"
              else
                echo "FAIL|L4 :$port $comment|tcp://$port|CLOSED" > "$RESULTS/l4_$port"
              fi
            ) &
          done
          wait

          # Collect results
          echo ""
          echo "════════════════════════════════════════"
          PASS_N=0; FAIL_N=0; WARN_N=0
          for f in "$RESULTS"/*; do
            [ -f "$f" ] || continue
            LINE=$(cat "$f")
            STATUS=$(echo "$LINE" | awk -F'|' '{print $1}')
            NAME=$(echo "$LINE" | awk -F'|' '{print $2}')
            URL=$(echo "$LINE" | awk -F'|' '{print $3}')
            CODE=$(echo "$LINE" | awk -F'|' '{print $4}')
            case "$STATUS" in
              PASS) echo "✓ $NAME — $URL — $CODE"; PASS_N=$((PASS_N + 1)) ;;
              FAIL) echo "::error::$NAME — $URL — $CODE"; FAIL_N=$((FAIL_N + 1)) ;;
              WARN) echo "::warning::$NAME — $URL — $CODE"; WARN_N=$((WARN_N + 1)) ;;
            esac
          done

          echo ""
          echo "RESULT: $PASS_N passed, $FAIL_N failed, $WARN_N warnings"
          if [ "$FAIL_N" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::$FAIL_N URL(s) failed"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All public URLs healthy"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Generate cloud-data configs from build.json + topology ──
# Usage: ship-gen-configs.sh
set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
export GIT_BASE="${GIT_BASE:-$(dirname "$REPO_ROOT")}"

echo "── Generating cloud-data ──"
bash build.sh config

echo "── Committing cloud-data ──"
cd cloud-data
git config user.name "${GIT_AUTHOR_NAME:-github-actions[bot]}"
git config user.email "${GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL:-github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com}"

git stash --include-untracked 2>/dev/null || true
git checkout main 2>/dev/null || true
git pull --rebase origin main 2>/dev/null || true
git stash pop 2>/dev/null || true

git add -A *.json *.md 2>/dev/null || true
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "cloud-data: no changes"
  exit 0
fi

git commit -m "auto: regenerate cloud-data [skip ci]"
git push origin main

echo "── Updating submodule ref ──"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
git config user.name "${GIT_AUTHOR_NAME:-github-actions[bot]}"
git config user.email "${GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL:-github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com}"
git checkout -- . 2>/dev/null || true
git add cloud-data
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "main repo: submodule ref unchanged"
  exit 0
fi
git commit -m "auto: update cloud-data submodule ref [skip ci]"
git push origin main

name: "Ship → gen-configs (cloud-data)"

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "a_solutions/*/build.json"
      - "config.json"
      - "a_solutions/ba-clo_cloudflare/src/main.tf"
      - "b_infra/vps_*/src/main.tf"
      - "b_infra/home-manager/**/src/*.nix"
      - "a_solutions/bb-sec_caddy/src/**"
      - "a_solutions/bb-sec_authelia/src/**"
      - "a_solutions/ba-clo_hickory-dns/src/**"
      - "a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-infra-mcp/src/engines/**"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: gen-configs
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Update submodules to latest
        run: git submodule update --remote
          fetch-depth: 0
          ssh-key: ${{ secrets.CLOUD_DATA_DEPLOY_KEY }}

      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-deps

      - name: Generate cloud-data (topology + configs + deps)
        env:
          GIT_BASE: ${{ github.workspace }}/../
        run: bash build.sh config

      - name: Commit and push cloud-data submodule
        run: |
          cd cloud-data
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          # Stash generated files, checkout main, pop stash, pull latest
          git stash --include-untracked
          git checkout main
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git stash pop || true
          git add -A *.json *.md
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "cloud-data: no changes"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "auto: regenerate cloud-data from build.json + config.json [skip ci]"
          git push origin main

      - name: Update submodule reference in main repo
        run: |
          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          # Reset any nix/cache modifications, keep only cloud-data change
          git checkout -- . 2>/dev/null || true
          git add cloud-data
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "main repo: submodule ref unchanged"
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "auto: update cloud-data submodule ref [skip ci]"
          # Push main repo via HTTPS + GITHUB_TOKEN (deploy key only works for cloud-data)
          git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/diegonmarcos/cloud.git"
          git push origin main

on:

  packages: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: google-workspace-mcp
            context: a_solutions/aa-sui_google-workspace-mcp/src
            file: a_solutions/aa-sui_google-workspace-mcp/src/Dockerfile
          - name: mail-mcp
            context: a_solutions/aa-sui_mail-mcp/src
            file: a_solutions/aa-sui_mail-mcp/src/Dockerfile
          - name: mattermost-mcp
            context: a_solutions/aa-sui_mattermost-mcp/src
            file: a_solutions/aa-sui_mattermost-mcp/src/Dockerfile
          - name: introspect-proxy
            context: a_solutions/bb-sec_introspect-proxy/src
            file: a_solutions/bb-sec_introspect-proxy/src/Dockerfile
          - name: c3-infra-mcp
            context: a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-infra-mcp/src
            file: a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-infra-mcp/src/Dockerfile
          - name: c3-infra-api
            context: a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-infra-api/src
            file: a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-infra-api/src/Dockerfile
          - name: c3-services-mcp
            context: a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-services-mcp/src
            file: a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-services-mcp/src/Dockerfile
          - name: c3-services-api
            context: a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-services-api/src
            file: a_solutions/bc-obs_c3-services-api/src/Dockerfile
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Update submodules to latest
        run: git submodule update --remote

      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Resolve symlinks in build context
        run: |
          # Replace symlinks with real copies so Docker can access them
          ctx="${{ matrix.context }}"
          find "$ctx" -maxdepth 1 -type l | while read link; do
            target=$(readlink -f "$link")
            rm "$link"
            cp -r "$target" "$link"
          done

      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ matrix.context }}
          file: ${{ matrix.file }}
          push: true
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/diegonmarcos/${{ matrix.name }}:latest
            ghcr.io/diegonmarcos/${{ matrix.name }}:${{ github.sha }}
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.name }}
          cache-to: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.name }},mode=max

dags/gha/ship-ghcr.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Build + push all Docker images to GHCR ──
# Portable: works in GHA, Dagu, CLI
# Usage: ship-ghcr.sh [service-filter]
set -euo pipefail

FILTER="${1:-}"
REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

GHA_CONFIG="cloud-data/cloud-data-gha-config.json"
if [ ! -f "$GHA_CONFIG" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: $GHA_CONFIG not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Get all Docker-enabled services
SERVICES=$(jq -r '
  .services | to_entries[]
  | select(.value.has_docker == true)
  | [.value.dir, .key, (.value.docker_image // "")]
  | join("|")
' "$GHA_CONFIG")

if [ -z "$SERVICES" ]; then
  echo "No Docker services found"
  exit 0
fi

OK=0
FAIL=0

echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "Ship → GHCR images"
echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════"

echo "$SERVICES" | while IFS='|' read -r dir name image; do
  if [ -n "$FILTER" ] && [ "$dir" != "$FILTER" ] && [ "$name" != "$FILTER" ]; then
    continue
  fi

  BUILD_SH="a_solutions/${dir}/build.sh"
  if [ ! -f "$BUILD_SH" ]; then
    echo "SKIP $name (no build.sh)"
    continue
  fi

  echo ""
  echo "── Build: $name ($dir) ──"

  if bash "$BUILD_SH" docker; then
    echo "OK $name"
    OK=$((OK + 1))

    # Make package public
    pkg_name=$(echo "$image" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}')
    if [ -n "$pkg_name" ] && command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      gh api --method PUT "/user/packages/container/${pkg_name}/visibility" -f visibility=public 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  else
    echo "FAIL $name (exit $?)"
    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "GHCR: $OK ok, $FAIL failed"

[ "$FAIL" -gt 0 ] && exit 1
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Deploy home-manager to a VM ──
# Usage: ship-home-manager.sh <vm-alias>
#   Omit vm to deploy to all VMs
set -euo pipefail

VM="${1:-}"
REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

VMS="${VM:-gcp-proxy gcp-t4 oci-mail oci-analytics oci-apps}"
OK=0; FAIL=0

for vm in $VMS; do
  HM_DIR="b_infra/home-manager/${vm}"
  if [ ! -d "$HM_DIR" ]; then
    echo "SKIP $vm (no home-manager dir)"
    continue
  fi
  echo "── Ship home-manager: $vm ──"
  if bash "${HM_DIR}/build.sh" ship; then
    echo "OK $vm"
    OK=$((OK + 1))
  else
    echo "FAIL $vm (exit $?)"
    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
  fi
done

echo "Home-manager: $OK ok, $FAIL failed"
[ "$FAIL" -gt 0 ] && exit 1
exit 0

dags/gha/ship-home-manager.yml

name: "Ship → home-manager"

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "b_infra/home-manager/**"
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      vm:
        description: "Target VM (gcp-proxy, gcp-t4, oci-mail, oci-analytics, oci-apps, oci-apps-2, or empty for all)"
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: home-manager-deploy
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - vm: gcp-proxy
            host_secret: GCP_PROXY_HOST
            user_secret: GCP_PROXY_USER
            key_secret: GCP_PROXY_SSH_KEY
          - vm: gcp-t4
            host_secret: GCP_T4_HOST
            user_secret: GCP_T4_USER
            key_secret: GCP_T4_SSH_KEY
            optional: true
          - vm: oci-mail
            host: "130.110.251.193"
            user: "ubuntu"
            key_secret: OCI_SSH_KEY
          - vm: oci-analytics
            host: "129.151.228.66"
            user: "ubuntu"
            key_secret: OCI_SSH_KEY
          - vm: oci-apps
            host: "82.70.229.129"
            user: "ubuntu"
            key_secret: OCI_SSH_KEY

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: ${{ matrix.vm }}
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.optional || false }}

    steps:
      - name: Check if should run
        id: gate
        run: |
          EVENT="${{ github.event_name }}"
          TARGET="${{ inputs.vm }}"
          VM="${{ matrix.vm }}"
          if [ "$EVENT" != "workflow_dispatch" ] || [ -z "$TARGET" ] || [ "$TARGET" = "$VM" ]; then
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Skipping $VM (target: $TARGET)"
          fi

      - name: Checkout
        if: steps.gate.outputs.skip != 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Update submodules to latest
        if: steps.gate.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: git submodule update --remote

      - name: Resolve host/user
        if: steps.gate.outputs.skip != 'true'
        id: resolve
        run: |
          # GCP VMs use secrets for dynamic IPs, OCI VMs use static
          HOST="${{ matrix.host }}"
          USER="${{ matrix.user }}"
          [ -z "$HOST" ] && HOST="${{ secrets[matrix.host_secret] }}"
          [ -z "$USER" ] && USER="${{ secrets[matrix.user_secret] }}"
          echo "host=$HOST" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "user=$USER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Setup deps
        if: steps.gate.outputs.skip != 'true'
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-deps
        with:
          ssh_key: ${{ secrets[matrix.key_secret] }}
          ssh_host: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.host }}
          ssh_user: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.user }}
          ssh_alias: ${{ matrix.vm }}
          sops_age_key: ${{ secrets.SOPS_AGE_KEY }}

      - name: Check VM reachable
        id: reachable
        if: steps.gate.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          HOST="${{ steps.resolve.outputs.host }}"
          if [ -z "$HOST" ] || ! ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "${{ matrix.vm }}" 'echo ok' 2>/dev/null; then
            if [ "${{ matrix.optional }}" = "true" ]; then
              echo "::notice::${{ matrix.vm }} is unreachable (optional VM) — skipping"
              echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            else
              echo "::error::${{ matrix.vm }} is unreachable"
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Ship home-manager
        id: ship
        if: steps.gate.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.reachable.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: bash b_infra/home-manager/${{ matrix.vm }}/build.sh ship

      - name: Report failure
        if: failure() && steps.ship.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          echo "::error::Home Manager deployment failed for ${{ matrix.vm }}"
          echo "Check the 'Ship home-manager' step above for nix build errors"

dags/gha/ship-terraform.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Run terraform plan+apply for cloud providers ──
# Usage: ship-terraform.sh [project]
#   project: cloudflare, gcloud, oci, aws, hetzner (omit for all)
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT="${1:-}"
REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

declare -A TF_DIRS=(
  [cloudflare]="a_solutions/ba-clo_cloudflare/src"
  [gcloud]="b_infra/vps_gcloud/src"
  [oci]="b_infra/vps_oci/src"
  [aws]="b_infra/vps_aws/src"
  [hetzner]="b_infra/vps_hetzner/src"
)

OK=0; FAIL=0; SKIP=0

for name in cloudflare gcloud oci aws hetzner; do
  if [ -n "$PROJECT" ] && [ "$PROJECT" != "$name" ]; then
    continue
  fi

  dir="${TF_DIRS[$name]}"
  if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
    echo "SKIP $name (dir $dir not found)"
    SKIP=$((SKIP + 1))
    continue
  fi

  echo "── Terraform: $name ($dir) ──"
  cd "$REPO_ROOT/$dir"

  terraform init -input=false || { echo "FAIL $name (init)"; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); cd "$REPO_ROOT"; continue; }
  terraform plan -input=false -out=tfplan || { echo "FAIL $name (plan)"; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); cd "$REPO_ROOT"; continue; }
  terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve tfplan || { echo "FAIL $name (apply)"; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); cd "$REPO_ROOT"; continue; }

  echo "OK $name"
  OK=$((OK + 1))
  cd "$REPO_ROOT"
done

echo "Terraform: $OK ok, $FAIL failed, $SKIP skipped"
[ "$FAIL" -gt 0 ] && exit 1
exit 0

dags/gha/ship-terraform.yml

name: "Ship → terraform"

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "a_solutions/ba-clo_cloudflare/src/**"
      - "b_infra/vps_gcloud/src/**"
      - "b_infra/vps_oci/src/**"
      - "b_infra/vps_aws/src/**"
      - "b_infra/vps_hetzner/src/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ship-terraform.yml"
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      project:
        description: "Target project (cloudflare, gcloud, oci, aws, or empty for all changed)"
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: terraform
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  terraform:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Update submodules to latest
        run: git submodule update --remote
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Detect changes
        id: changes
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          filters: |
            cloudflare:
              - 'a_solutions/ba-clo_cloudflare/src/**'
            gcloud:
              - 'b_infra/vps_gcloud/src/**'
            oci:
              - 'b_infra/vps_oci/src/**'
            aws:
              - 'b_infra/vps_aws/src/**'
            hetzner:
              - 'b_infra/vps_hetzner/src/**'

      - name: Force project override
        id: force
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        run: |
          proj="${{ inputs.project }}"
          for name in cloudflare gcloud oci aws hetzner; do
            if [ -z "$proj" ] || [ "$proj" = "$name" ]; then
              echo "$name=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            fi
          done

      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # Setup — Nix (for sops), Terraform, cloud CLIs
      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v30
        with:
          nix_path: nixpkgs=channel:nixos-24.11

      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: "1.9"

      - name: Setup SOPS age key
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.config/sops/age
          echo "${{ secrets.SOPS_AGE_KEY }}" > ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt
          chmod 600 ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt

      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # Cloudflare — DNS, Email Routing, Tunnel
      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

      - name: Terraform — Cloudflare
        if: steps.changes.outputs.cloudflare == 'true' || steps.force.outputs.cloudflare == 'true'
        working-directory: a_solutions/ba-clo_cloudflare/src
        env:
          TF_VAR_cloudflare_api_key: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          # Decrypt sops secrets → inject into tfvars
          nix-shell -p sops --run "sops -d secrets.yaml" > /tmp/cf-secrets.env
          # Build tfvars from template + secrets
          cp terraform.tfvars.template terraform.tfvars
          CF_API_KEY=$(grep 'cloudflare_api_key' /tmp/cf-secrets.env | awk -F': ' '{print $2}' | tr -d '"' || echo "$TF_VAR_cloudflare_api_key")
          awk -v key="$CF_API_KEY" '{gsub(/INJECTED_FROM_SECRETS/, key)}1' terraform.tfvars > terraform.tfvars.tmp && mv terraform.tfvars.tmp terraform.tfvars
          rm -f /tmp/cf-secrets.env

          terraform init -input=false
          terraform plan -input=false -out=tfplan
          terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve tfplan

      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # GCP — VMs, firewall, budget
      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

      - name: Authenticate GCP
        if: steps.changes.outputs.gcloud == 'true' || steps.force.outputs.gcloud == 'true'
        uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
        with:
          credentials_json: ${{ secrets.GCP_SA_KEY }}

      - name: Terraform — GCP
        if: steps.changes.outputs.gcloud == 'true' || steps.force.outputs.gcloud == 'true'
        working-directory: b_infra/vps_gcloud/src
        env:
          TF_VAR_ssh_public_key: ${{ secrets.GCP_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
        run: |
          cp terraform.tfvars.template terraform.tfvars
          awk -v key="$TF_VAR_ssh_public_key" '{gsub(/FILL_FROM_VAULT/, key)}1' terraform.tfvars > terraform.tfvars.tmp && mv terraform.tfvars.tmp terraform.tfvars

          terraform init -input=false
          terraform plan -input=false -out=tfplan
          terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve tfplan

      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # OCI — VMs, VCN, security lists
      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

      - name: Terraform — OCI
        if: steps.changes.outputs.oci == 'true' || steps.force.outputs.oci == 'true'
        working-directory: b_infra/vps_oci/src
        env:
          TF_VAR_tenancy_ocid: ${{ secrets.OCI_TENANCY_OCID }}
          TF_VAR_compartment_ocid: ${{ secrets.OCI_COMPARTMENT_OCID }}
          TF_VAR_region: ${{ secrets.OCI_REGION }}
          OCI_CLI_USER: ${{ secrets.OCI_USER_OCID }}
          OCI_CLI_TENANCY: ${{ secrets.OCI_TENANCY_OCID }}
          OCI_CLI_FINGERPRINT: ${{ secrets.OCI_FINGERPRINT }}
          OCI_CLI_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.OCI_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          OCI_CLI_REGION: ${{ secrets.OCI_REGION }}
        run: |
          terraform init -input=false
          terraform plan -input=false -out=tfplan
          terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve tfplan

      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # AWS — SES email relay, IAM
      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

      - name: Terraform — AWS
        if: steps.changes.outputs.aws == 'true' || steps.force.outputs.aws == 'true'
        working-directory: b_infra/vps_aws/src
        env:
          AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
          AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
          AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
        run: |
          terraform init -input=false
          terraform plan -input=false -out=tfplan
          terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve tfplan

      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      # Hetzner — VMs (placeholder, ready for provisioning)
      # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

      - name: Terraform — Hetzner
        if: steps.changes.outputs.hetzner == 'true' || steps.force.outputs.hetzner == 'true'
        working-directory: b_infra/vps_hetzner/src
        env:
          TF_VAR_hcloud_token: ${{ secrets.HETZNER_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          terraform init -input=false
          terraform plan -input=false -out=tfplan
          terraform apply -input=false -auto-approve tfplan

dags/gha/ship-vm.sh

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ── Ship all services for a VM ──
# Portable: works in GHA, Dagu, CLI
# Usage: ship-vm.sh <vm-alias> [service-filter]
#   vm-alias: gcp-proxy, oci-apps, oci-mail, oci-analytics, gcp-t4
#   service-filter: optional, only ship this service dir (e.g. bc-obs_dagu)
set -euo pipefail

VM="${1:?Usage: ship-vm.sh <vm-alias> [service-filter]}"
FILTER="${2:-}"
REPO_ROOT="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

GHA_CONFIG="cloud-data/cloud-data-gha-config.json"
if [ ! -f "$GHA_CONFIG" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: $GHA_CONFIG not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Get services for this VM
SERVICES=$(jq -r --arg vm "$VM" '
  .services | to_entries[]
  | select(.value.vm == $vm)
  | [.value.dir, .key, (.value.has_docker // false | tostring)]
  | join("|")
' "$GHA_CONFIG")

if [ -z "$SERVICES" ]; then
  echo "No services found for VM: $VM"
  exit 0
fi

# Detect changed dirs (GHA provides HEAD~1, CLI/Dagu ships all)
CHANGED_DIRS=""
if [ -n "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" ] && [ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:-}" != "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
  CHANGED_DIRS=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -- 'a_solutions/*/src/' 2>/dev/null | awk -F/ '{print $2}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
fi

OK=0
FAIL=0
SKIP=0
TOTAL=$(echo "$SERVICES" | wc -l)

echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "Ship → $VM ($TOTAL services)"
echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════"

echo "$SERVICES" | while IFS='|' read -r dir name has_docker; do
  # Apply filter
  if [ -n "$FILTER" ] && [ "$dir" != "$FILTER" ] && [ "$name" != "$FILTER" ]; then
    continue
  fi

  # Skip unchanged (only in GHA push events)
  if [ -n "$CHANGED_DIRS" ] && ! echo "$CHANGED_DIRS" | grep -q "$dir"; then
    echo "SKIP $name (unchanged)"
    SKIP=$((SKIP + 1))
    continue
  fi

  BUILD_SH="a_solutions/${dir}/build.sh"
  if [ ! -f "$BUILD_SH" ]; then
    echo "SKIP $name (no build.sh)"
    SKIP=$((SKIP + 1))
    continue
  fi

  echo ""
  echo "── Ship: $name ($dir) ──"

  # Set REMOTE_BUILD for Docker services
  if [ "$has_docker" = "true" ]; then
    export REMOTE_BUILD="true"
  else
    unset REMOTE_BUILD 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if bash "$BUILD_SH" ship; then
    echo "OK $name"
    OK=$((OK + 1))
  else
    echo "FAIL $name (exit $?)"
    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════"
echo "Ship → $VM: $OK ok, $FAIL failed, $SKIP skipped (of $TOTAL)"

[ "$FAIL" -gt 0 ] && exit 1
exit 0

name: "Ship → {{VM_NAME}}"

on:
  push:
    paths:
{{PATH_FILTERS}}    branches: [main]

{{SSH_CONFIG}}          sops_age_key: ${{ secrets.SOPS_AGE_KEY }}
{{DOCKER_STEPS}}
      - name: Ship services
        run: bash .github/workflows/scripts/ship-vm.sh {{VM_NAME}}

dags/gha/sync-submodules.yml

name: Auto-sync submodules

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update submodules to latest
        run: |
          git submodule update --remote
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git add .
            git commit -m "auto: update submodules [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi

dags/health_cloud-full.yaml

schedule: "0 6 * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
mailOn:
  failure: true
  success: false
steps:
  - name: run-cloud-health
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      # Run health_cloud.ts inside the C3 API container (has all deps + SSH keys)
      RESULT=$($SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.6 "docker exec c3-infra-mcp-api npx tsx mcp/tools/health_cloud.ts 2>&1") || true

      if [ -z "$RESULT" ]; then
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/infra_cloud-health" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: Cloud Health FAILED — could not run check" \
          -H "Priority: 5" \
          -H "Tags: rotating_light,cloud" \
          -d "health_cloud.ts returned empty output"
        exit 1
      fi

      # Parse JSON result
      STATUS=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.status // .overall // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
      SUMMARY=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.summary // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo "$RESULT" | tail -10)
      FAILS=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.failed // 0' 2>/dev/null || echo "?")

      if [ "$STATUS" = "ok" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "healthy" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "pass" ] || [ "$FAILS" = "0" ]; then
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/infra_cloud-health" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: Cloud Health OK" \
          -H "Priority: 2" \
          -H "Tags: white_check_mark,cloud" \
          -d "$(echo -e "All layers passed\n\n$SUMMARY\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")"
      else
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/infra_cloud-health" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: Cloud Health FAILED ($FAILS issues)" \
          -H "Priority: 5" \
          -H "Tags: rotating_light,cloud" \
          -d "$(echo -e "Status: $STATUS\n\n$SUMMARY\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")"
        exit 1
      fi

dags/health_dns-resolution.yaml

schedule: "0 8 * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: check-dns-and-notify
    command: |
      FAILED=""
      DOMAINS=$(if [ -f "$MON_TARGETS" ]; then jq -r '.dns_checks[]' "$MON_TARGETS"; else echo -e "diegonmarcos.com\nauth.diegonmarcos.com\nvault.diegonmarcos.com\napi.diegonmarcos.com\nanalytics.diegonmarcos.com\nmail.diegonmarcos.com"; fi)
      for domain in $DOMAINS; do
        RESULT=$(dig +short "$domain" @1.1.1.1 2>&1)
        if [ -z "$RESULT" ]; then
          FAILED="${FAILED}  - $domain -> NO RECORDS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1)\n"
        fi
      done
      if [ -n "$FAILED" ]; then
        MSG=$(echo -e "DNS resolution failures:\n${FAILED}\nAction:\n  dig <domain> @1.1.1.1\n  dig <domain> @8.8.8.8\n  Check Cloudflare DNS dashboard\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/infra_dns" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: DNS Resolution FAILED" \
          -H "Priority: 5" \
          -H "Tags: rotating_light" \
          -d "$MSG"
        exit 1
      fi

dags/health_docker-containers.yaml

schedule: "0 10 * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: check-containers-and-notify
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      ALERTS=""
      VM_LIST=$(if [ -f "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" ]; then
  jq -r '.vms[] | "\(.ip):\(.name):\(.user)"' "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" | tr '\n' ' '
else
  echo "10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:diego 10.0.0.3:oci-mail:ubuntu 10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:ubuntu 10.0.0.6:oci-apps:ubuntu"
fi
)
      for vm_data in $VM_LIST; do
        ip=${vm_data%%:*}
        temp=${vm_data#*:}
        name=${temp%:*}
        user=${temp#*:}
        UNHEALTHY=$($SSH $user@$ip "docker ps --filter health=unhealthy --format '{{.Names}}'" 2>/dev/null)
        EXITED=$($SSH $user@$ip "docker ps -a --filter status=exited --filter 'exited!=0' --format '{{.Names}} (exit {{.Status}})'" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -n "$UNHEALTHY" ]; then
          ALERTS="${ALERTS}  $name — UNHEALTHY:\n"
          while IFS= read -r c; do
            ALERTS="${ALERTS}    - $c\n"
          done <<< "$UNHEALTHY"
        fi
        if [ -n "$EXITED" ]; then
          ALERTS="${ALERTS}  $name — CRASHED:\n"
          while IFS= read -r c; do
            ALERTS="${ALERTS}    - $c\n"
          done <<< "$EXITED"
        fi
      done
      if [ -n "$ALERTS" ]; then
        MSG=$(echo -e "Container issues:\n${ALERTS}\nAction:\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'docker logs <container> --tail 30'\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'docker restart <container>'\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/infra_containers" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: Container Health Issues" \
          -H "Priority: 4" \
          -H "Tags: whale,warning" \
          -d "$MSG"
        exit 1
      fi

schedule: "*/5 * * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: check-mesh-and-notify
    command: |
      FAILED=""
      PEERS=$(if [ -f "$MON_TARGETS" ]; then jq -r '.vms[] | "\(.ip):\(.name):22"' "$MON_TARGETS"; else echo -e "10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:22\n10.0.0.3:oci-mail:25\n10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:22"; fi)
      echo "$PEERS" | while IFS=: read -r ip name port; do
        [ -z "$ip" ] && continue
        if ! echo QUIT | timeout 3 bash -c "cat > /dev/tcp/$ip/$port" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "  - $name ($ip) port $port UNREACHABLE" >> /tmp/mesh-failed.$$
        fi
      done
      if [ -f /tmp/mesh-failed.$$ ]; then
        FAILED=$(cat /tmp/mesh-failed.$$)
        rm -f /tmp/mesh-failed.$$
        MSG=$(printf "Unreachable peers:\n%s\n\nAction:\n  ssh <vm> 'wg show'\n  ssh <vm> 'systemctl status wg-quick@wg0'\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070" "$FAILED")
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/infra_mesh-health" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: Mesh Health FAILED" \
          -H "Priority: 5" \
          -H "Tags: rotating_light" \
          -d "$MSG"
        exit 1
      fi

dags/health_service-endpoints.yaml

schedule: "*/5 * * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: check-endpoints-and-notify
    command: |
      FAILED=""
      ENDPOINTS=$(if [ -f "$MON_TARGETS" ]; then jq -r '.endpoint_checks[] | "\(.url):\(.name)"' "$MON_TARGETS"; else echo -e "https://auth.diegonmarcos.com/api/health:Authelia 2FA\nhttps://vault.diegonmarcos.com/:Vaultwarden\nhttps://api.diegonmarcos.com/c3-api/health:C3 API"; fi)
      echo "$ENDPOINTS" | while IFS=: read -r proto rest; do
        [ -z "$proto" ] && continue
        svc=${rest##*:}
        url="$proto:${rest%:*}"
        HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 5 "$url" 2>/dev/null || echo "000")
        if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 400 ]; then
          echo "  - $svc ($url) -> HTTP $HTTP_CODE" >> /tmp/endpoints-failed.$$
        fi
      done
      if [ -f /tmp/endpoints-failed.$$ ]; then
        FAILED=$(cat /tmp/endpoints-failed.$$)
        rm -f /tmp/endpoints-failed.$$
        MSG=$(printf "DOWN endpoints:\n%s\n\nAction:\n  curl -v https://<domain>\n  ssh gcp-proxy 'docker logs caddy --tail 20'\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070" "$FAILED")
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/infra_endpoints" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: Service Endpoint DOWN" \
          -H "Priority: 5" \
          -H "Tags: rotating_light" \
          -d "$MSG"
        exit 1
      fi

dags/health_system-resources.yaml

schedule: "0 9 * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: check-resources-and-notify
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      ALERTS=""
      VM_LIST=$(if [ -f "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" ]; then
  jq -r '.vms[] | "\(.ip):\(.name):\(.user)"' "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" | tr '\n' ' '
else
  echo "10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:diego 10.0.0.3:oci-mail:ubuntu 10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:ubuntu 10.0.0.6:oci-apps:ubuntu"
fi
)
      for vm_data in $VM_LIST; do
        ip=${vm_data%%:*}
        temp=${vm_data#*:}
        name=${temp%:*}
        user=${temp#*:}
        DISK=$($SSH $user@$ip "df -h / | awk 'NR==2 {print substr(\$5,1,length(\$5)-1)}'" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")
        MEM=$($SSH $user@$ip "free | awk 'NR==2 {printf \"%.0f\", (\$3/\$2)*100}'" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")
        LOAD=$($SSH $user@$ip "cat /proc/loadavg | awk '{print \$1}'" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")
        if [ "$DISK" != "N/A" ] && [ "$DISK" -gt 80 ] 2>/dev/null || [ "$MEM" != "N/A" ] && [ "$MEM" -gt 90 ] 2>/dev/null; then
          ALERTS="${ALERTS}  - $name ($ip): disk=$DISK% mem=$MEM% load=$LOAD\n"
        fi
      done
      if [ -n "$ALERTS" ]; then
        MSG=$(echo -e "High resource usage:\n${ALERTS}\nAction:\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'df -h && free -h && top -bn1 | head -15'\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'docker stats --no-stream'\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/infra_resources" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: System Resources Alert" \
          -H "Priority: 4" \
          -H "Tags: warning,chart_with_upwards_trend" \
          -d "$MSG"
        exit 1
      fi

dags/ops_backup-check.yaml

schedule: "0 11 * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
  - BACKUP_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-backup-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: check-backups-and-notify
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      ALERTS=""
      VM_LIST=$(if [ -f "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" ]; then
  jq -r '.vms[] | "\(.ip):\(.name):\(.user)"' "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" | tr '\n' ' '
else
  echo "10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:diego 10.0.0.3:oci-mail:ubuntu 10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:ubuntu 10.0.0.6:oci-apps:ubuntu"
fi
)
      for vm_data in $VM_LIST; do
        ip=${vm_data%%:*}
        temp=${vm_data#*:}
        name=${temp%:*}
        user=${temp#*:}
        RECENT=$($SSH $user@$ip "find /var/backups -name '*.sql.gz' -o -name '*.tar.gz' -o -name '*.bak' 2>/dev/null | head -5 | while read f; do stat --format='%n (%s bytes, %y)' \"\$f\" 2>/dev/null; done | head -5" 2>/dev/null)
        COUNT=$($SSH $user@$ip "find /var/backups -name '*.sql.gz' -mtime -1 2>/dev/null | wc -l" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$COUNT" -eq 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
          ALERTS="${ALERTS}  $name ($ip): NO backups in last 24h\n"
          if [ -n "$RECENT" ]; then
            ALERTS="${ALERTS}    Latest files:\n"
            while IFS= read -r f; do
              ALERTS="${ALERTS}      $f\n"
            done <<< "$RECENT"
          fi
        fi
      done
      if [ -n "$ALERTS" ]; then
        MSG=$(echo -e "Backup freshness issues:\n${ALERTS}\nAction:\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'ls -lt /var/backups/ | head -10'\n  Check backup cron: ssh <user>@<ip> 'crontab -l'\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/ops_backups" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: Backup Alert" \
          -H "Priority: 4" \
          -H "Tags: floppy_disk,warning" \
          -d "$MSG"
        exit 1
      fi

dags/ops_backup-databases.yaml

schedule: "0 3 * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ""
  - AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${OCI_S3_SECRET_KEY}
  - RESTIC_REPOSITORY: "s3:https://axpmn3qtq4ig.compat.objectstorage.eu-marseille-1.oraclecloud.com/cloud-backups-db"
  - RESTIC_PASSWORD: ${RESTIC_PASSWORD}
mailOn:
  failure: true
  success: false
steps:
  # ── Phase 1: Dump databases on each VM (parallel) ──────────────────
  - name: dump-oci-apps
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      $SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.6 bash <<'REMOTE'
        set -e
        mkdir -p /var/backups/databases
        cd /var/backups/databases

        for spec in \
          "mattermost-postgres:mattermost:mattermost" \
          "crawlee_db:crawlee:crawlee" \
          "hedgedoc_postgres:hedgedoc:hedgedoc" \
          "etherpad_postgres:etherpad:etherpad" \
          "nocodb-db:nocodb:nocodb" \
          "windmill-db:windmill:windmill" \
          "quant_light_db:quantlab:quantlab" \
          "quant_full_db:quantlab:quantlab"
        do
          container=${spec%%:*}
          rest=${spec#*:}
          user=${rest%%:*}
          db=${rest#*:}
          if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "$container"; then
            docker exec "$container" pg_dump -U "$user" -d "$db" 2>/dev/null | gzip > "${container}-$(date +%Y%m%d).sql.gz" && \
              echo "OK $container" || echo "FAIL $container"
          else
            echo "SKIP $container (not running)"
          fi
        done

        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "photoprism_mariadb"; then
          docker exec photoprism_mariadb mariadb-dump -u root photoprism 2>/dev/null | gzip > "photoprism_mariadb-$(date +%Y%m%d).sql.gz" && \
            echo "OK photoprism_mariadb" || echo "FAIL photoprism_mariadb"
        fi

        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "surrealdb"; then
          docker exec surrealdb surreal export --conn http://localhost:8000 /tmp/surreal-export.surql 2>/dev/null && \
            docker cp surrealdb:/tmp/surreal-export.surql - | gzip > "surrealdb-$(date +%Y%m%d).surql.gz" && \
            echo "OK surrealdb" || echo "FAIL surrealdb"
        fi

        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "gitea"; then
          docker exec gitea sqlite3 /data/gitea/gitea.db ".backup '/tmp/gitea-dump.db'" 2>/dev/null && \
            docker cp gitea:/tmp/gitea-dump.db - | gzip > "gitea-$(date +%Y%m%d).sqlite.gz" && \
            echo "OK gitea" || echo "FAIL gitea"
        fi

        ls -lh /var/backups/databases/*$(date +%Y%m%d)* 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs -I{} echo "Total: {} dumps"
      REMOTE

  - name: dump-gcp-proxy
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      $SSH diego@10.0.0.1 bash <<'REMOTE'
        set -e
        sudo mkdir -p /var/backups/databases

        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "vaultwarden"; then
          docker exec vaultwarden sqlite3 /data/db.sqlite3 ".backup '/tmp/vw-dump.db'" && \
            docker cp vaultwarden:/tmp/vw-dump.db /var/backups/databases/vaultwarden-$(date +%Y%m%d).sqlite && \
            gzip -f /var/backups/databases/vaultwarden-$(date +%Y%m%d).sqlite && \
            echo "OK vaultwarden" || echo "FAIL vaultwarden"
        fi

        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "authelia"; then
          docker exec authelia cat /config/db.sqlite3 > /var/backups/databases/authelia-$(date +%Y%m%d).sqlite && \
            gzip -f /var/backups/databases/authelia-$(date +%Y%m%d).sqlite && \
            echo "OK authelia" || echo "FAIL authelia"
        fi

        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "ntfy"; then
          docker exec ntfy sqlite3 /var/cache/ntfy/cache.db ".backup '/tmp/ntfy-dump.db'" 2>/dev/null && \
            docker cp ntfy:/tmp/ntfy-dump.db /var/backups/databases/ntfy-$(date +%Y%m%d).sqlite && \
            gzip -f /var/backups/databases/ntfy-$(date +%Y%m%d).sqlite && \
            echo "OK ntfy" || echo "FAIL ntfy"
        fi
      REMOTE

  - name: dump-oci-mail
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      $SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.3 bash <<'REMOTE'
        set -e
        mkdir -p /var/backups/databases

        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx "stalwart"; then
          # Stalwart uses RocksDB — export via stalwart-mail --export
          docker exec stalwart stalwart-mail --export /tmp/stalwart-export 2>/dev/null && \
            docker cp stalwart:/tmp/stalwart-export /var/backups/databases/stalwart-$(date +%Y%m%d) && \
            tar czf /var/backups/databases/stalwart-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz -C /var/backups/databases stalwart-$(date +%Y%m%d) && \
            rm -rf /var/backups/databases/stalwart-$(date +%Y%m%d) && \
            docker exec stalwart rm -rf /tmp/stalwart-export && \
            echo "OK stalwart" || echo "FAIL stalwart"
        fi
      REMOTE

  - name: dump-oci-analytics
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      $SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.4 bash <<'REMOTE'
        set -e
        mkdir -p /var/backups/databases

        if docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q "matomo"; then
          MATOMO_CTR=$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep matomo | head -1)
          docker exec "$MATOMO_CTR" mysqldump -u matomo matomo 2>/dev/null | gzip > /var/backups/databases/matomo-$(date +%Y%m%d).sql.gz && \
            echo "OK matomo" || echo "FAIL matomo"
        fi
      REMOTE

  # ── Phase 2: Collect dumps to oci-apps + restic to OCI S3 ─────────
  - name: collect-and-upload
    depends:
      - dump-oci-apps
      - dump-gcp-proxy
      - dump-oci-mail
      - dump-oci-analytics
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      $SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.6 bash <<REMOTE
        set -e
        STAMP=\$(date +%Y%m%d)
        COLLECT="/var/backups/collected"
        mkdir -p "\$COLLECT"

        # Copy local oci-apps dumps
        cp /var/backups/databases/*\${STAMP}* "\$COLLECT/" 2>/dev/null || true

        # Pull from remote VMs
        for vm in "diego@10.0.0.1" "ubuntu@10.0.0.3" "ubuntu@10.0.0.4"; do
          rsync -az -e "ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR" \
            --ignore-missing-args "\$vm:/var/backups/databases/*\${STAMP}*" "\$COLLECT/" 2>/dev/null && \
            echo "Pulled from \$vm" || echo "No dumps from \$vm"
        done

        echo "Collected:"
        ls -lh "\$COLLECT/"*\${STAMP}* 2>/dev/null

        # Restic backup to OCI Object Storage
        export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
        export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
        export RESTIC_REPOSITORY="$RESTIC_REPOSITORY"
        export RESTIC_PASSWORD="$RESTIC_PASSWORD"

        command -v restic >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Installing restic..."; sudo apt-get install -y restic >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo snap install restic 2>/dev/null; }

        restic init 2>/dev/null || true
        restic backup "\$COLLECT/" --tag "databases" --tag "\$STAMP" --verbose && \
          echo "restic upload OK" || echo "restic upload FAILED"

        restic forget --keep-daily 7 --keep-weekly 4 --keep-monthly 6 --prune 2>/dev/null

        # Clean local dumps older than 3 days
        find /var/backups/databases -name "*.gz" -o -name "*.sqlite.gz" -mtime +3 -delete 2>/dev/null
        find "\$COLLECT" -name "*.gz" -o -name "*.sqlite.gz" -mtime +3 -delete 2>/dev/null
      REMOTE

  # ── Phase 3: Notify ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: notify
    depends:
      - collect-and-upload
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      COUNT=$($SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.6 "ls /var/backups/collected/*$(date +%Y%m%d)* 2>/dev/null | wc -l")
      SIZE=$($SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.6 "du -sh /var/backups/collected/ 2>/dev/null | awk '{print \$1}'" || echo "N/A")
      MSG="DB backup → OCI S3: $COUNT dumps ($SIZE)\nBucket: cloud-backups-db\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070"
      curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/ops_backups" \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
        -H "Title: Daily DB Backup OK ($COUNT dumps)" \
        -H "Priority: 2" \
        -H "Tags: floppy_disk,white_check_mark" \
        -d "$(echo -e "$MSG")"

dags/ops_backup-media.yaml

schedule: "0 4 * * 0"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ""
  - AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${OCI_S3_SECRET_KEY}
  - RESTIC_REPOSITORY: "s3:https://axpmn3qtq4ig.compat.objectstorage.eu-marseille-1.oraclecloud.com/cloud-backups-media"
  - RESTIC_PASSWORD: ${RESTIC_PASSWORD}
mailOn:
  failure: true
  success: false
steps:
  - name: backup-media
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      $SSH ubuntu@10.0.0.6 bash <<REMOTE
        set -e
        STAMP=\$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M)

        # Collect from remote VMs first
        mkdir -p /var/backups/media/gcp-proxy /var/backups/media/oci-mail
        RSYNC_SSH="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"

        rsync -az --delete -e "\$RSYNC_SSH" diego@10.0.0.1:/opt/containers/vaultwarden/data/ /var/backups/media/gcp-proxy/vaultwarden/ 2>/dev/null && \
          echo "OK vaultwarden" || echo "SKIP vaultwarden"
        rsync -az --delete -e "\$RSYNC_SSH" diego@10.0.0.1:/opt/containers/caddy/data/ /var/backups/media/gcp-proxy/caddy/ 2>/dev/null && \
          echo "OK caddy" || echo "SKIP caddy"
        rsync -az --delete -e "\$RSYNC_SSH" ubuntu@10.0.0.3:/opt/containers/stalwart/data/ /var/backups/media/oci-mail/stalwart/ 2>/dev/null && \
          echo "OK stalwart" || echo "SKIP stalwart"

        # Restic to OCI Object Storage (Archive tier bucket)
        export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
        export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
        export RESTIC_REPOSITORY="$RESTIC_REPOSITORY"
        export RESTIC_PASSWORD="$RESTIC_PASSWORD"

        command -v restic >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Installing restic..."; sudo apt-get install -y restic >/dev/null 2>&1; }

        restic init 2>/dev/null || true
        restic backup \
          /opt/containers/photoprism/data \
          /opt/containers/gitea/data \
          /opt/containers/radicale/data \
          /opt/containers/filebrowser/data \
          /var/backups/media/gcp-proxy \
          /var/backups/media/oci-mail \
          --tag "media" --tag "\$STAMP" --verbose 2>&1 | tail -10

        restic forget --keep-daily 7 --keep-weekly 4 --keep-monthly 6 --prune 2>/dev/null
        echo "Media backup complete"
      REMOTE

  - name: notify
    depends:
      - backup-media
    command: |
      MSG="Weekly media backup → OCI S3 (Archive)\nBucket: cloud-backups-media\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070"
      curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/ops_backups" \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
        -H "Title: Weekly Media Backup OK" \
        -H "Priority: 2" \
        -H "Tags: floppy_disk,white_check_mark" \
        -d "$(echo -e "$MSG")"

dags/ops_capacity-review.yaml

schedule: "0 9 * * 1"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: review-capacity-and-notify
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      REPORT=""
      VM_LIST=$(if [ -f "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" ]; then
  jq -r '.vms[] | "\(.ip):\(.name):\(.user)"' "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" | tr '\n' ' '
else
  echo "10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:diego 10.0.0.3:oci-mail:ubuntu 10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:ubuntu 10.0.0.6:oci-apps:ubuntu"
fi
)
      for vm_data in $VM_LIST; do
        ip=${vm_data%%:*}
        temp=${vm_data#*:}
        name=${temp%:*}
        user=${temp#*:}
        DISK_DETAIL=$($SSH $user@$ip "df -h / | awk 'NR==2 {print \"Used: \" \$3 \"/\" \$2 \" (\" \$5 \")\"}'" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")
        DOCKER_IMAGES=$($SSH $user@$ip "docker system df --format '{{.Type}}\t{{.Size}}' 2>/dev/null | head -3 | awk '{print \"    \" \$0}'" 2>/dev/null || echo "    N/A")
        LARGEST=$($SSH $user@$ip "du -sh /opt/containers/*/data 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head -3 | awk '{print \"    \" \$0}'" 2>/dev/null || echo "    N/A")
        REPORT="${REPORT}$name ($ip):\n  Disk: $DISK_DETAIL\n  Docker storage:\n$DOCKER_IMAGES\n  Largest data dirs:\n$LARGEST\n\n"
      done
      MSG=$(echo -e "Weekly Capacity Review:\n\n${REPORT}Action:\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'docker system prune -f'\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'du -sh /opt/containers/*/data | sort -rh'\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")
      curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/ops_summary" \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
        -H "Title: Weekly Capacity Review" \
        -H "Priority: 2" \
        -H "Tags: bar_chart" \
        -d "$MSG"

dags/ops_cron-status.yaml

schedule: "0 7 * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: check-timers-and-notify
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      ALERTS=""
      VM_LIST=$(if [ -f "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" ]; then
  jq -r '.vms[] | "\(.ip):\(.name):\(.user)"' "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" | tr '\n' ' '
else
  echo "10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:diego 10.0.0.3:oci-mail:ubuntu 10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:ubuntu 10.0.0.6:oci-apps:ubuntu"
fi
)
      for vm_data in $VM_LIST; do
        ip=${vm_data%%:*}
        temp=${vm_data#*:}
        name=${temp%:*}
        user=${temp#*:}
        FAILED_TIMERS=$($SSH $user@$ip "systemctl list-timers --failed --no-legend 2>/dev/null" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        if [ -n "$FAILED_TIMERS" ]; then
          ALERTS="${ALERTS}  $name ($ip):\n"
          while IFS= read -r t; do
            ALERTS="${ALERTS}    - $t\n"
          done <<< "$FAILED_TIMERS"
        fi
      done
      if [ -n "$ALERTS" ]; then
        MSG=$(echo -e "Failed systemd timers:\n${ALERTS}\nAction:\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'systemctl list-timers --failed'\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'journalctl -u <timer-name> --since yesterday'\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")
        curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/ops_cron" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
          -H "Title: Cron/Timer Failures" \
          -H "Priority: 4" \
          -H "Tags: warning,clock1" \
          -d "$MSG"
        exit 1
      fi

schedule: "0 19 * * *"
env:
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN: ${AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN}
  - MON_TARGETS: /var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json
mailOn:
  failure: false
  success: false
steps:
  - name: collect-deploys-and-notify
    command: |
      SSH="ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR"
      REPORT=""
      TOTAL=0
      VM_LIST=$(if [ -f "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" ]; then
  jq -r '.vms[] | "\(.ip):\(.name):\(.user)"' "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" | tr '\n' ' '
else
  echo "10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:diego 10.0.0.3:oci-mail:ubuntu 10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:ubuntu 10.0.0.6:oci-apps:ubuntu"
fi
)
      for vm_data in $VM_LIST; do
        ip=${vm_data%%:*}
        temp=${vm_data#*:}
        name=${temp%:*}
        user=${temp#*:}
        RESTARTS=$($SSH $user@$ip "journalctl -u docker --since '24 hours ago' 2>/dev/null | grep 'Container.*Started' | awk '{print \$NF}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5 | awk '{print \"    \" \$2 \" (\" \$1 \"x)\"}'" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
        COUNT_RAW=$($SSH $user@$ip "journalctl -u docker --since '24 hours ago' 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'Container.*Started' || echo 0" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        COUNT=$(echo "$COUNT_RAW" | tr -dc '0-9')
        COUNT=${COUNT:-0}
        TOTAL=$((TOTAL + COUNT))
        if [ "${COUNT:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
          REPORT="${REPORT}$name ($ip): $COUNT restarts\n"
          if [ -n "$RESTARTS" ]; then
            REPORT="${REPORT}$RESTARTS\n"
          fi
          REPORT="${REPORT}\n"
        fi
      done
      MSG=$(echo -e "Deploy Digest (24h): $TOTAL total restarts\n\n${REPORT}Action:\n  ssh <user>@<ip> 'docker ps --format \"table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\"'\n\nDagu: http://10.0.0.3:8070")
      curl -s -X POST "$NTFY_URL/cicd_deploy-digest" \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUTHELIA_BEARER_TOKEN" \
        -H "Title: Daily Deploy Digest ($TOTAL restarts)" \
        -H "Priority: 2" \
        -H "Tags: rocket" \
        -d "$MSG"

dags/ops_docker-prune.yaml

schedule: "0 4 */3 * *"
env:
  - SSH: ssh -i /root/.ssh/vault_id_rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o LogLevel=ERROR
  - NTFY_URL: http://10.0.0.1:8090
  - VM_LIST: 10.0.0.6:oci-apps:ubuntu 10.0.0.3:oci-mail:ubuntu 10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:ubuntu 10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:diego
mailOn:
  failure: true
  success: false
steps:
  - name: prune-all-vms
    command: |
      REPORT=""
      for entry in $VM_LIST; do
        IP=$(echo "$entry" | cut -d: -f1)
        NAME=$(echo "$entry" | cut -d: -f2)
        USER=$(echo "$entry" | cut -d: -f3)

        echo "=== Pruning $NAME ($IP) ==="
        BEFORE=$($SSH "$USER@$IP" "df --output=used / | tail -1" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")

        RESULT=$($SSH "$USER@$IP" "docker system prune -af 2>&1 | tail -1" 2>/dev/null || echo "FAILED")

        AFTER=$($SSH "$USER@$IP" "df --output=used / | tail -1" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
        FREED=$(( (BEFORE - AFTER) / 1024 ))

        echo "  $NAME: $RESULT (freed ~${FREED}MB)"
        REPORT="$REPORT\n$NAME: $RESULT (freed ~${FREED}MB)"
      done

      echo ""
      echo "=== Summary ==="
      echo -e "$REPORT"

      # Notify via ntfy
      curl -sf -d "Docker prune complete:$(echo -e "$REPORT")" \
        -H "Title: Docker Prune" \
        -H "Tags: broom" \
        "$NTFY_URL/ops" 2>/dev/null || true

      REPORT=""
      VM_LIST=$(if [ -f "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" ]; then
  jq -r '.vms[] | "\(.ip):\(.name):\(.user)"' "/var/lib/dagu/data/cloud-data/cloud-data-monitoring-targets.json" | tr '\n' ' '
else
  echo "10.0.0.1:gcp-proxy:diego 10.0.0.3:oci-mail:ubuntu 10.0.0.4:oci-analytics:ubuntu 10.0.0.6:oci-apps:ubuntu"

)

        REPORT="${REPORT}$name ($ip):\n  Uptime: $UPTIME\n  Containers: $CONTAINERS | Disk: $DISK | Mem: $MEM\n\n"
